description: This file defines an Android Activity 'LoaderCursor' that demonstrates using a CursorLoader to load and display contact data within a ListFragment. It includes inner classes for managing search functionalities and cursor loading, as well as handling user interactions and filtering contact data.

classes.name: LoaderCursor
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating contact loading with CursorLoader and search functionality.

classes.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment that displays contacts using a CursorLoader and provides search filtering capabilities.

classes.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment.MySearchView
classes.description: A custom SearchView that clears its query when collapsed.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the contact list fragment if not already added.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with a search item and sets up the SearchView.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles search text changes to update the contact filter and restart loader.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles the submission of search queries (no special handling here).

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Clears search query when SearchView is closed.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up the list adapter, initializes loader, and prepares the fragment view.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader to load contacts, optionally applying a filter.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Swaps in the new cursor and displays the contact list.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears the adapter cursor when loader is reset.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Logs the ID of the clicked contact item (placeholder for custom behavior).

methods.name: MySearchView
methods.description: Custom SearchView that clears text when collapsed.
